fact: The Ministry of Health says 6,427 public facilities, 38 DHA-certified private facilities and 38 of 518 faith-based facilities have completed migration from the SHA Provider Portal to the Health Management Information System.
The Council of Governors committed to support Level 5 hospitals to complete their transition to the Health Management Information System, per the Ministry of Health.

A Ministry statement of 1 October says all 6,427 public Level 2 to 4 facilities have transitioned to HMIS, 4 of 27 public Level 5 hospitals have, and 38 of 518 faith-based facilities have; the Digital Health Agency has certified 28 HMIS platforms.

Duale says HMIS is part of the government's ongoing rollout, with all 6,427 public Level 2 to 4 facilities transitioned, 4 Level 5 migrated and 23 in progress, and 28 HMIS platforms certified by the Digital Health Agency.
Duale says 6,427 public Level 2 to 4 facilities have transitioned to HMIS from the SHA provider portal and extended the deadline for the rest to 30 October 2026.
The Ministry of Health has set 30 October 2026, in a published notice, as the deadline for health providers to move to the national government's Health Management Information System.
The Cabinet Secretary said the Comprehensive Integrated Health Information System is operational in 17 counties, with rollout to Homabay, Kisumu, Nakuru, Lamu and others in the coming weeks.
